sourceSystem.description: Indicates the source system from which this canonical is imported

timestamp.description: Indicates the timestamp of the canonical in source system

sourcesId.description: Id of the {@link Sources} for the Source

channel.description: unique string for a given for a measurement from an measuring device of an asset or from a meter at a service point.

accumulation.description:
accumulation indicates how measurements are accumulated. Possible values are "register", "instantaneous", "delta", "indicative".

“delta” means difference between reading at start time and end time; example: electricity consumption interval data
“indicating” means ‘what the meter would show' measured over a long, measurable time period; example: voltage measured over an interval
“register” means a cumulative reading from a dial at a point in time; example: monthly electricity consumption reading
“instantaneous” means a reading of a non-cumulative value at a point in time' example: temperature measurement at a moment in time

intervalLength.description: interval length of measurements - QUARTER_HOUR, HOUR, DAY, MONTH

multiplier.description: multiplication factor to be applied to the readings

title: Represents the point of usage (meter/channel) for which interval data is provided.
